name: TEMPESTUS DAGGERS
text: Every friendly Tempestus Aquilon except the Servo-Sentry carries a Tempestus dagger (Atk 3, Hit 4+, Dmg 3/4) for the battle. The Precursor keeps its own dagger as well.

name: COMBAT STIMMS
text: The Move loss from being injured does not apply to friendly Tempestus Aquilons; the Hit penalty still does.

name: DROP AUGURY
text: Once per battle, when a friendly operative set up above is activated, before it lands or stays: move one of your Drop markers up to 4 inches horizontally, but not closer to your opponent's drop zone.

name: REMOTE OVERSEER
text: Once per battle, after the initiative roll-off of a turning point, you may re-roll your own die.
